justification: The assessment's verdict is VALID, so by the grading rule it is MISSED. Notably it did surface the same lemma as the ground truth ('metabelian_injectivity', L.0531-0535: ad(v): gr_i(Lbar) -> gr_{i+1}(Lbar) injective for all nonzero v in V_0 and all i) and even gave an i=1 counterexample, but it explicitly judged the over-statement repairable ('correct for all i>=2', applications only need infinitely many i) and concluded VALID with empty flawed_step and counterexample fields. The ground truth witness shows the failure is not confined to i=1 (in Lbar = F/(Sym(V_0).r) with r=[x,[x,y]], ad(x) kills a=[x,y] in gr_2), so the dismissal was also substantively wrong. Either way, a VALID verdict is graded MISSED.
